book.name: HECHOS
book.title: JA' SK'ANEAL TZETTAJ YETAL JIX EL YUNEN EB ẌEJAB JESÚS

content: Ja' Yet Jix To Pablo Bey Macedonia Yetoj Bey Grecia
Ja' yet jix lawi jun jowal tu', catu' jix yalon naj Pablo tol chi syamba oc sba eb creyente yu yak'le can nioj xa sna'bal eb. Catu' jix yalon tet eb: “Jaxa jin to yul yet Macedonia ti' an,” ẍi naj.
Ja' yet jix apni titu', jix ec' yil masanil eb creyente bey jun jun conob, catu' jix ec' ale can oc sna'bal eb yu naj. Catu' jix to bey Grecia.

Oxeb xaaw jix ey ec' titu'. Chi yoche chi oc yul barco catu' chi to bey Siria. Pero jix yabeni, tol ey eb Israel chi yoche chi mitx'oni, yuxan jix sna' tol yel watx' chi meltzo pax bey Macedonia junel xa.

Ja' yet jix to tu', ey wan eb creyente jix to yetoj. Jix to naj Sópater a Berea, jix to naj Aristarco, jix to naj Segundo a Tesalónica, yetoj naj Gayo a Derbe, c'al naj Timoteo. Ey pax cawan eb a Asia jix to yetoj, naj Tíquico yetoj naj Trófimo.
Ja' yet jix apni eb bey conob Filipos, jix can Pablo yu eb titu'. Catu' jix babitoj eb bey conob Troas. Ja' titu' jix cu yechbane eb.

Jal jaonti' xin, ja' bey conob Filipos jix kechbane kilon jun k'in, yet chi lo'le ixim pan c'am yich. Yet jix lawi c'al ec' jun k'in tu', catu' jix cu to yul barco. Joeb c'u jix cu bey yiban ja' mar. Catu' jix cu apni bey conob Troas. Ja' titu' jix kil-le cu ba yetoj eb jix babitoj cu sattaj tu'. Jujeb c'u jix cu ec' titu'.
Ja' Yet Ey Ec' Pablo Bey Conob Troas

Ja' yet domingo, jix cu yamba cu ba yetoj eb creyente masanil. Catu' jix cu lo'on ixim pan, sna'baniltej naj Kaawil. Ja' Pablo jix ak'on cuybanile tet eb creyente. Tuxa chi toi, yuxan caw ey tzet jix yal can tet eb, masanta' c'al jix oc chuman ak'bal.
Ja' yul jun cuarto yiban, ja' tu' jix syamba sba eb. Ec'al tzejtebal jix yaoc eb.

Ey jun naj ach'e chi yij Eutico. Chotan eltoj naj sti' ventana. Chi noxi naj sweyi, yutol miman jix yute yajan cuybanile naj Pablo. Jix tit xa c'al weyan yin naj sic'lebil, catu' jix tit pitxna naj tu'. Ja' bey yet yox xijan bey jix tit q'uey naj. Camnaj xa naj yet jix sic'le a oj.
Ja' yet jix apni Pablo xin, catu' jix ey motz'an naj, catu' jix lak'le a naj yu. Jix yalon tet eb creyente jaxca ti': —Manchej jex xiwi, iquis to naj, ẍi naj tet eb.
Catu' jix cu atoj yul cuarto tu' yetoj naj Pablo junel xa. Jix spo'on ec' ixim pan cu xol. Catu' jix cu lo'on ixim. Ec'al to c'al tzet jix yal Pablo tu', masanta' c'al jix sajbi el oj. Catu' jix toi.
Ja' naj ach'e jix pitzc'u a tu' xin, jix i'letoj yu eb bey sna. Caw chi tzala eb yutol iquis naj.
Ja' Yet Jix Tit Eb Bey Troas Catu' Jix To Eb Bey Mileto
Jaonti', jix cu oc yul barco, catu' jix cu to bey conob Ason. Ja' tu' jix kechbane yapni Pablo jaxca jix yute yalon e on. Yutol yin yajan naj jix toi.
Ja' yet jix apni Pablo cu c'atan bey conob Ason tu', jix oc yul barco ketoj, catu' jix cu to yetoj bey Mitilene.

Catu' jix cu toi, ja' yet jun xa c'ual jix cu ec' scawilal jun tx'otx' snan ja' Quio sbi. Jun xa c'ual xin, jix cu apni bey jun xa tx'otx' chi yij Samos. [Ja' bey conob Trogilio, bey sti' ja' mar tu', jix cu xewi.] Yet jun xa c'ual jix cu k'axpone, catu' jix cu apni bey conob Mileto.
Catu' jix cu toi, yutol ma yal sc'ul Pablo chi cu ec' bey conob Efeso, yutol chi yoche yin eymanil chi cu ec' bey Asia tu', yet watx' chi cu tzaji apnoj kilon k'in Pentecostés bey Jerusalén.
Ja' Tzet Jix Yal Can Naj Pablo Tet Eb Anciano A Efeso
Ja' yet jix cu apni bey conob Mileto, catu' jix yaontoj ẍejab naj Pablo sc'atan eb anciano a Efeso, yu bet yawteletej eb.
Ja' yet jix apni eb, catu' jix yalon tet eb jaxca ti': —Jaexti', je yotaj xa jin beybal, yet tax c'al jix jin jul ec' bey Asia ti'.
Ey jin c'al oc wak'on servil naj Kaawil yin eyilal tobal k'inal. Ey bey jix jin ok' sic'lebil yu eb ánima. Ec'al el jix jin ak'le porobal yu wan tzet man watx' oj jix yaoc eb wet Israelal wiban an.
Pero je yotaj, tol ma jin bej walon wan cuybanile watx' e ex, tol je watx'ilal oj chi yun yel oc apnoj. Jix wal sk'ane Dios e ex sattaj conob, c'al bey je na.
Jix wal tet eb Israel an, c'al tet eb man Israel oj an, tol sowalil chi sna' sba sc'ul eb sattaj Dios, catu' chi yaoc oc sc'ul eb yin naj Kaawil Jesucristo.
Ja' tinani', oj jin toj bey Jerusalén, yutol chin i'letoj yu Santo Espíritu. Man wotaj oj tzet oj jul wiban titu'.
Pero wotaj an, ja' jun jun conob bey chin eq'ui, chi yal Santo Espíritu e in an, tol sowalil oj jin oc preso titu', catu' miman sya'ilal oj wil an.

Pero c'am chin xiw yu wan tu'. Cax c'al chin cam yu, pero c'am yel oc apnoj jun camich tu' yul jin sat. Asanne chi wak' lawoj jun jin mulnail ti' yin tzala c'ulal. Catu' chi lawi wopiso yak'naj can naj Kaawil Jesús tu' e in an, jun opiso yin alo el sk'aneal yet colbanile yu swatx' c'ulal Dios.
Ec'naj jin wal e ex an, tzet che yune' yet chi oc Dios je Yaawil oj. Ja' tinani', wotaj an, tol c'am xa bak'in oj kil-le cu ba.
Yuxan, ja' tinani', chi wal can oj, tol c'am xa walon wet yin junoj mac txequel.
Yutol albil masanil scuybanil Dios e ex wu an. C'am junoj tzet jix jin weba el e ex.
Yuxan, teyne wej c'al je ba, catu' che teynen pax eb creyente masanil, yutol ak'bil je yopiso yu Santo Espíritu je yilon yiglesia naj Kaawil. Eb jix manle yetoj ẍiq'uil yet jix cam ku c'al.
Yutol wotaj an, tol ja' yet oj jin toj, ey wan eb oj jul je c'atan. Oj yak'le eb jex yuchon sajlem oj, jaxca chi yute yujten ec' no' me' no' oj.
Yet pax ja' je xol jaexti', ey wan eb oj txeclo a oj, catu' oj yak'on wan lek'ti'al eb yu yak'on sc'ul oj eb creyente, yet watx' chi oc eb yetoj eb.
Yuxan, teyne wej c'al je ba. Na' wej tej, tol oxeb xa jabil jaxca c'al ti' jex jin cuyon jun jun jex, c'ualil c'al ak'balil. Tol ey bey chin ok'i yet chex jin cuyoni.

Ja' tinani' xin, jex wuẍtaj, chex wak' can oc abenal yul sk'ab Dios. Ja' oj jex teynen yetoj sk'ane. Ja' sk'ane tu', caw jix x'ox swatx' c'ulalil e on, ey yipal sk'ane tu' yak'on cu tec'anil, c'al yak'on cu sattaj, yutol ey xa kalon ket yetoj eb sic'bil xa el yu.
Jainti', c'am bey jix woche oc stumin junoj ánima, cax c'al spichil junoj ánima.
Je yotaj, caw chin mulna yetoj jin k'ab, yu tzet chi oc yopiso wu an, c'al tzet chi oc yopiso yu eb wetbi an.

Tobal k'inal jix jin tx'ox e ex an, tzet utbil tol sowalil chi kil cu mulnail, yet watx' chi ske' cu colwa yin eb ya' ey. Sowalil chi cu na'tej tzet yalnaj naj Kaawil junel yet jix yalon can naj jaxca ti': “Yel watx' ket yet cu sa'oni tet yet chi cu cha'on pax oj,” ẍi naj, ẍi Pablo tet eb anciano tu'.
Yet jix lawi yalon wan ti' naj Pablo, catu' jix ey kaan oj. Jix txali yetoj masanil eb tu'.
Yet jix lawi xali eb xin, catu' jix mi'cha sc'ul eb yok' masanil. Jix yak'le can scawil sc'ul yin cam c'ulalil.
Caw jix cus eb sic'lebil, yutol jix yal tet eb, tol c'am xa bak'in oj yil-le sba eb yetoj. Ja' yet jix to Pablo tu', jix bet ak'le can yu eb masanta' c'al bey jix oc yul barco tu'.
